name: Breadcrumb
description: A trail of links showing where you are, with the middle steps folded into a menu when it gets long.

props.name: children
props.description: Breadcrumb elements, from the top of the hierarchy down to the current page.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: The most crumbs to show, counting the "…" button. Past this the middle crumbs fold into a menu, keeping the first and the last.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the id of a crumb that is pressed. Useful for crumbs without an href.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables every link in the trail.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the list. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Breadcrumbs.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the crumb leads. Ignored on the last crumb, which is the current page.

props.name: id
props.description: Passed to onAction when the crumb is pressed.

props.name: linkProps
props.description: Props for the inner react-aria-components Link, such as target or routerOptions.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the list item.
